children: SlowMist co-founder Yu Xuan said on X that users should pay more attention to cases in which the delivery app ComeCome used a similar method to steal crypto assets than to the FomoPeek app case on iPhone. According to Odaily, some seemingly normal apps may infect users after being used, and the issue has occurred on iPhone. Yu Xuan advised users to update to the latest iOS version promptly and said iPad and Mac may also be affected.

title: Security Researcher Urges iPhone Users to Update iOS After Malicious App Cases
